rules.statement: The incorporeal right attached to a route through prescription remains valid even if the route deviates, unless there is an intentional and deliberate abandonment.
rules.supporting_quote: The servitude attached to the new deviated route on the basis of prescription. The right is an incorporeal right and the particular route affects only the manner of its exercise. The right is not lost by the deviation on the basis of abandonment unless the abandon�ment is intentional and deliberate
